Change the concentricity callout (S1) to a runout tolerance referenced to the bearing datum axis.","recommended_correction":"Replace the concentricity GD&T symbol with a circular or total runout control relative to the bearing axis datum."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D6","page":1,"quote":"200±0.02"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N6","page":1,"quote":"# FINISH : I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"Dimension D6 has a tolerance band of 0.04 mm and the part is zinc plated per note N6, but the tight tolerance does not account for plating thickness buildup. This can cause the finished feature to fall out of tolerance after plating. The designer must either open the pre-plate machining tolerance to absorb the coating thickness or explicitly state that the dimension applies after plating.","recommended_correction":"Adjust the tolerance on D6 to allow for plating thickness, or add a note specifying that the dimension applies after surface treatment."}]}
